title: SG-1 · Set up UI stack, design system and responsive shell
summary: Configure the UI stack in game/frontend and ship a responsive shell with a UI store and header overlay
description: Context: game/frontend is a React 18 + Vite app whose layout is a plain CSS grid (src/styles.css, GameLayout.tsx) with local useState drawer state and a RoundBadge/Countdown rendered inside the scene. It has no Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix, Zustand, Motion or Lucide. Desired behavior: the stack is configured, a Zustand store owns UI flags, the shell is a full-viewport 80/20 layout with a mobile bottom drawer, and a compact header overlay shows the world and round state. Why: this is the foundation for the Phaser redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frontend package, when package.json and tailwind config are read, then tailwindcss, radix, zustand, motion and lucide-react are declared and Tailwind scans src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
Given the UI store, when its actions are called, then drawer, modal, sound and settings flags change as specified
Given a desktop viewport, when the shell renders, then the game area has the 80% column class and the story panel the 20% column class with overflow hidden on the root
Given a mobile viewport, when the shell renders, then the story panel is a bottom drawer toggled by the store and the scene stays mounted
Given the header overlay, when rendered, then it shows logo, world name, round ID, status, countdown, sound toggle and settings button

in_scope: game/frontend config, store, GameLayout, header overlay, App composition

technical_constraints: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Zustand, Motion, Lucide React
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with passing unit tests
non_functional: No page scroll or horizontal overflow
